#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, k;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &k);
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) scanf("%d", &arr[i]);
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    vector<int> gaps;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i != 0 && even == odd) {
            gaps.push_back(abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]));
        }
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) even++;
        else odd++;
    }
    sort(gaps.begin(), gaps.end());
    int count = 0;
    for (int g : gaps) {
        if (g <= k) {
            count++;
            k -= g;
        } else break;
    }
    printf("%d\n", count);
    return 0;
}
